message: Close <html> explicitly: add </html> at the end of the file.
Close <body> explicitly: add </body> at the end of the file.
<form> is never closed: it runs to the end of the file. Add </form> where it should end.
<textarea/> doesn’t close the element: HTML ignores "/" on non-void elements, so <textarea> stays open and swallows everything up to the end of the file. Write <textarea></textarea>.
